question_en: List Samsung's contributions to Work Item NR_Mob_enh2-Core across earlier meetings (contribution history).
original_query: MATCH (t:Tdoc)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company {companyName: 'Samsung'}), (t)-[:RELATED_TO]->(wi:WorkItem {workItemCode: 'NR_Mob_enh2-Core'}), (t)-[:PRESENTED_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN t.tdocNumber, t.title, t.status, m.canonicalMeetingNumber ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC, t.tdocNumber ASC LIMIT 10
reference_query:
MATCH (t:Tdoc)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(:Company {companyName:'Samsung'})
MATCH (t)-[:RELATED_TO]->(:WorkItem {workItemCode:'NR_Mob_enh2-Core'})
MATCH (t)-[:PRESENTED_AT]->(m:Meeting)
RETURN DISTINCT t.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber, m.meetingNumberInt AS meetingNumberInt
ORDER BY meetingNumberInt DESC, tdocNumber ASC
